description: This file defines the MenuDao class, a data access object responsible for querying and updating menu items within the OrangeHRM core plugin. It includes methods for enabling/disabling module menu items, retrieving menu items by module and screen, and fetching menu items for side panels and top menus based on user roles. The class interacts with entities such as MenuItem, Module, and UserRole, utilizing query builders for database operations.

classes.name: MenuDao
classes.description: A data access object class for managing menu items, including enabling/disabling menu items, retrieving menu items based on module, screen, and user roles, and constructing hierarchical menu structures.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items associated with a specific module and optional menu titles.

methods.name: updateStatusOfModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Internal method to update status (enabled/disabled) of menu items for a given module and menu titles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a MenuItem entity based on module name and screen name.

methods.name: getSidePanelMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches top-level menu items for the side panel based on user roles.

methods.name: getTopMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves second level menu items (top menu) under a specific side menu item, along with their child items.

methods.name: getMenuItemQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder wrapper for fetching menu items accessible to a set of user roles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByTitle
methods.description: Finds a menu item by its title, optionally filtering by level.

methods.name: getModuleByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Module entity by its name.
